definitions.gloss: prevention of recurrence; measures to prevent reoccurrence
definitions.explanation: Steps taken to ensure that a problem, accident, mistake, or illness does not happen again. A key concept in Japanese business culture and quality management.

examples.japanese: {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think of measures to prevent recurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きない→起きる：00521_okiru⟧よう{再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: We are working on preventing the same mistake from happening again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧し、{再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company announced that it would thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident and work to prevent recurrence.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧ (recurrence) + ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (prevention). A very common term in business, healthcare, and government. In Japanese corporate culture, documenting {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく} (preventive measures) after an incident is a standard practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく}: preventive measures
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}める→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧: to strive to prevent recurrence
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on preventing recurrence
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧: incident prevention report

USAGE:
Often seen in formal apologies and press conferences when companies or organizations address problems. The phrase {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}めます→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧ ("We will strive to prevent recurrence") is a standard expression.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧: recurrence — of a disease, problem, or incident
- ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: prevention — used in many compounds
- ⟦{未然|みぜん}に{防|ふせ}ぐ→未然に防ぐ：17327_mizennifusegu⟧: to prevent before it happens — a more general preventive concept
